name: Bottled drinking water
notes: Sealed commercial drinking water; confirm the label.

name: Stored tap drinking water
notes: Count only clean tap water stored in a sanitized food-grade container and labelled drinking water.

name: Filtered drinking water
notes: Count only water known potable before or after filtering; a filter alone does not prove safety.

name: Boiled drinking water
notes: Count only water correctly boiled and cooled for drinking under local advice.

name: Sparkling drinking water
notes: Count only sealed sparkling water labelled for drinking.

name: Distilled water
notes: Exclude from long-term drinking-water planning; usually kept for appliances. It is not inherently poisonous.

name: Stored non-drinking water
notes: For washing or flushing only; never count as drinking water.

name: Water purification tablets
notes: Treatment supplies, not litres of water.
